verses.text: Sons, listen to what your dad is teaching you. Pay attention so you can get some understanding.
I'm giving you solid advice. Don't walk away from what I'm teaching you.
I was my father's son once, still small and my mother's only child in her eyes.
My dad taught me this: “Keep my words close to your heart. Follow my commands, and live.
Get wisdom. Get understanding. Don't forget what I tell you or wander away from it.
Don't leave wisdom behind, and she'll look after you. Love her, and she'll keep you safe.
Wisdom comes first, so go and get it. Even if it costs everything you've got, get understanding.
Value her, and she'll lift you up. Hold her close, and she'll bring you honor.
She'll set a wreath of grace on your head and hand you a beautiful crown.”
Listen, my son, and take my words in. You'll have many years to live.
I've shown you wisdom's way and led you along roads that run straight.
When you walk, nothing will hold your steps back. When you run, you won't trip.
Grab hold of instruction and don't let go. Keep it close. Your life depends on it.
Don't step onto the road the wicked take. Don't walk the way people who do evil walk.
Stay clear of it. Don't even go past it. Turn away and keep moving.
They can't sleep until they've done something wrong. They stay up until they've brought somebody down.
They eat wickedness like bread and drink violence like wine.
But the path of those who do right is like daybreak, getting brighter and brighter until it's full daylight.
The road of the wicked is pitch-dark. They have no idea what keeps tripping them up.
My son, pay attention to what I'm telling you. Lean in and listen.
Keep these words where you can see them, right in the middle of your heart.
They give life to whoever finds them and bring health to the whole body.
Be careful to guard your heart. That's where the springs of life flow from.
Cut out the twisted talk. Keep shady words far from your lips.
Look straight ahead. Keep your eyes on the road right in front of you.
Make the ground level where you step so every road you take is steady.
Don't veer right or left. Keep your feet away from evil.
